name: When should a criminal defense attorney consider investing in AEO?

mainEntity.name: When should a criminal defense attorney consider investing in AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: A criminal defense attorney should consider AEO when they notice a decline in online inquiries, struggle to compete in local search results, or want to future-proof their digital marketing strategy against evolving search technologies. It's particularly beneficial if your firm aims to capture a larger share of voice-activated searches or improve lead quality beyond what traditional SEO offers. Proactive investment can establish market leadership.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider AEO if online inquiries are declining, local search competition is high, or you want to future-proof your digital marketing for AI and voice search.
